Today, this treacherous pass is patrolled by the [[Stone Summit]], and as such is considered hostile to [[human]] travelers.}} [[Beacon's Perch]] is an outpost between the [[Northern Shiverpeaks|Northern]] and [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]. ==Getting there== There are several methods to get to Beacon's Perch: *Complete [[the Frost Gate]] mission. *Leave from [[The Frost Gate (outpost)|the Frost Gate outpost]] and travel through [[Anvil Rock]] and [[Deldrimor Bowl]]. *Leave from [[Yak's Bend]] and travel through [[Traveler's Vale]], [[Iron Horse Mine]], Anvil Rock, and Deldrimor Bowl. ==Quests available== *[[Master Saberlin]] **[[To Kryta: Refugees]] {{Quest icon|Primary}} **[[Hungry Devourer]] **[[The Deserters]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Hakon]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ====Henchmen==== *{{w}} 10 [[Little Thom]] (Brawler) *{{w}} 10 [[Stefan]] (Fighter) *{{r}} 10 [[Reyna]] (Archer) *{{mo}} 10 [[Alesia]] (Healer) *{{n}} 10 [[Claude]] (Cultist) *{{me}} 10 [[Dunham]] (Enchanter) *{{e}} 10 [[Orion]] (Mage) ====Other characters==== *{{x}} 4 [[Master Saberlin]] ==Notes== *Beacon's Perch is the starting point for the famous [[Guide to Drok's run|Droknar's Forge run]] through [[Lornar's Pass]], [[Dreadnought's Drift]], [[Snake Dance]] and [[Talus Chute]]. *Complete exploration of this outpost contributes 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. ==Trivia== *The in-game description is actually for Lornar's Pass. {{Towns and outposts in the Northern Shiverpeaks}}
